data.name: Vlinder
data.description: Vlinder is an Austria-headquartered nature-based climate company that develops mangrove restoration projects in Asia and Africa, generating blue carbon credits. They co-design projects with local communities, share at least 50% of carbon credits with local stakeholders, and have restored over 1,600 hectares with a larger pipeline.
